sources.name: CheatRunner
sources.description: Web-based PS5 cheat trainer for already-jailbroken PS5 consoles.

sources.name: Pegasus DL
sources.description: PS5 payload for direct package downloading and local file management through a web interface.

sources.name: Kylin Core
sources.description: PS5 homebrew cheat loader and real-time game modifier.

sources.name: WBrowser
sources.description: PS5 web browser project. Currently distributed upstream as PKG files rather than a PLDMGR-loadable payload.

sources.name: Ghostpad
sources.description: PS5 virtual DualSense payload for remote controller input over LAN, used with the Ghostpad PC app.

sources.name: Kura Loader
sources.description: Self-contained PS5 companion payload for Kura with a web dashboard, installs, cheats, saves, storage tools and console management.

sources.name: fetchpkg
sources.description: Downloads official Sony PS4/PS5 package updates from JSON manifests. Automatically built from ps5-payload-dev/fetchpkg source.

sources.name: pkg_install
sources.description: PS5 package-install helper payload. Automatically built from ps5-payload-dev/shsrv's pkg_install source.

sources.name: SVT Play Installer
sources.description: Installs the unofficial SVT Play 10-foot UI to the PS5 Media tab; streams are generally geo-restricted to Swedish IP addresses.

sources.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Info
sources.description: Parses PS5 Backup and Restore archive information and logs results locally and remotely.

sources.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Main Segments
sources.description: Parses a PS5 Backup and Restore archive and dumps special/main embedded segments.

sources.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Full Dump
sources.description: Dumps supported embedded files from a PS5 Backup and Restore archive to USB.

sources.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Save Data
sources.description: Parses PS5 Backup and Restore archives and dumps PS4/PS5 save-data files.

sources.name: Ghostcontrol
sources.description: Uses supported third-party USB controllers on PS5 by translating USB HID input into a virtual DualSense.

sources.name: RESTORE_PM
sources.description: Restores the Payload Manager tile on the PS5 home screen if it is missing or no longer opens.

sources.name: ProsperoPlayer
sources.description: PS5 homebrew media player for USB video, music and images with subtitles, resume playback and media controls.

sources.name: RetroArch PS5
sources.description: RetroArch homebrew bundle for PS5 with 33 libretro cores. Requires its full RetroArch-PS5.zip folder bundle and cannot run as a standalone PLDMGR payload.
sources.track_only_reason: Upstream ships RetroArch-PS5.zip containing retroarch.elf plus required cores, assets and configuration. A standalone ELF entry would be incomplete.

sources.name: JTPlay
sources.description: Native PS5 audio/video player with local filesystem, UPnP/DLNA and JavaScript media-provider plugins.
sources.track_only_reason: Upstream ships JTPlay.zip containing the executable plus required assets, fonts, plugins and CA bundle. It is a Homebrew Launcher package rather than a standalone PLDMGR payload.
